import requests

for acc, gene in [('Q6ZUM4', 'ARHGAP27'), ('Q8WX94', 'NLRP7')]:
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=accession:{acc}&format=fasta&includeIsoform=true")
    print(f"=== {gene} ({acc}) ===")
    for entry in r.text.strip().split('>')[1:]:
        header = entry.split('\n')[0]
        seq = "".join(entry.split('\n')[1:])
        analysed_seq = ProteinAnalysis(seq)
        mw = analysed_seq.molecular_weight()
        print(f"{header.split('|')[1] if '|' in header else header}: length={len(seq)} aa, MW={mw:.2f} Da ({mw/1000.0:.2f} kDa)")

import requests

def get_uniprot_info(gene_name):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search?query=gene_exact:{gene_name}+AND+organism_id:9606+AND+reviewed:true&fields=accession,id,gene_names,mass,length,sequence"
    resp = requests.get(url)
    data = resp.json()
    return data

for gene in ["ARHGAP27", "NLRP7"]:
    data = get_uniprot_info(gene)
    print(f"=== {gene} ===")
    for entry in data.get("results", []):
        acc = entry.get("primaryAccession")
        entry_name = entry.get("uniProtkbId")
        length = entry.get("sequence", {}).get("length")
        mass = entry.get("sequence", {}).get("molWeight")
        print(f"Accession: {acc}, ID: {entry_name}, Length: {length} aa, Mass: {mass} Da ({mass/1000.0:.2f} kDa)")
